desc:
This game is currently in alpha. Expect to encounter bugs and please report them to the developers.

🏘️ Welcome to My Town: Life Sim! Cast the residents, make the choices, and see what happens when everyone lives next door.

👥 Move in your Roblox friends as residents or create your own characters.
🎭 Pick their personalities and watch friendships, crushes, and rivalries unfold.
☕ Send residents out for coffee, karaoke, or a day at the park.
💬 Let them live their lives or step in when their stories take a turn.

Who will you move in first?

🐛 Use the in-game Feedback button to tell us what’s working and what needs a fix.
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite My Town to follow the alpha!
